# Dataset overview


```{r import-data, include=FALSE}
# ============================================================
# FILE PATHS
# ============================================================

# 1. REGISTRY DATASET
data_file <- "data/raw/synthetic_data.csv"

# 2. MASTER CODEBOOK
codebook_file <- "Dissertation_Aim1_Master_Codebook.xlsx"

# ============================================================
# IMPORT
# ============================================================

stopifnot(
  file.exists(data_file),
  file.exists(codebook_file)
)

# Import as text to preserve original codes and leading zeros.
dat <- read_csv(
  data_file,
  col_types = cols(.default = col_character()),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

region_codes <- read_excel(
  codebook_file,
  sheet = "Region Codes",
  col_types = "text"
)

comuna_codes <- read_excel(
  codebook_file,
  sheet = "Comuna Codes",
  col_types = "text"
)

country_codes <- read_excel(
  codebook_file,
  sheet = "Country Codes",
  col_types = "text"
)
```

```{r dataset-overview}
overview <- tibble(
  Measure = c(
    "Total registry records",
    "Unique individuals",
    "Number of variables"
  ),
  N = c(
    nrow(dat),
    n_distinct(dat$id_persona, na.rm = TRUE),
    ncol(dat)
  )
)

kable(overview, caption = "Initial registry overview")
```

# Analytic cohort

The working cohort includes confirmed (`ipd_cofirmado = SI`), non-discarded (`ipd_descartado = NO`) records. For individuals with multiple qualifying records, the earliest dated qualifying record is selected. Age (15–65 years) and calendar-year (2005–2023) restrictions are applied afterward.

## Prepare cohort variables

```{r prepare-cohort, include=FALSE}

parse_creation_date <- function(x) {
  x <- trimws(as.character(x))
  x[x == ""] <- NA_character_

  as.Date(
    parse_date_time(
      x,
      orders = c("dby", "ymd", "mdy"),
      locale = "C",
      quiet = TRUE
    )
  )
}

records <- dat %>%
  mutate(
    source_row = row_number(),
    creation_date = parse_creation_date(fecha_creacion_caso),
    creation_year = year(creation_date),
    age_at_creation = suppressWarnings(
      as.numeric(edad_ano_creacion_caso)
    ),
    confirmed = toupper(trimws(ipd_cofirmado)),
    discarded = toupper(trimws(ipd_descartado)),
    confirmed_b = !is.na(confirmed) &
      !is.na(discarded) &
      confirmed == "SI" &
      discarded == "NO"
  )
```

## Select the analytic cohort

```{r analytic-cohort}
qualifying_records <- records %>%
  filter(confirmed_b)


dated_qualifying <- qualifying_records %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(id_persona),
    trimws(id_persona) != "",
    !is.na(creation_date)
  )

first_confirmed <- dated_qualifying %>%
  arrange(id_persona, creation_date, source_row) %>%
  group_by(id_persona) %>%
  slice(1) %>%
  ungroup()

analytic_dat <- first_confirmed %>%
  filter(
    between(age_at_creation, 15, 65),
    between(creation_year, 2005, 2023)
  )

cohort_summary <- tibble(
  Measure = c(
    "Total registry records",
    "Unique registry individuals",
    "Individuals with a confirmed, non-discarded record and valid date",
    "Final analytic cohort"
  ),
  N = c(
    nrow(records),
    n_distinct(
      records$id_persona[
        !is.na(records$id_persona) &
          trimws(records$id_persona) != ""
      ]
    ),
    nrow(first_confirmed),
    nrow(analytic_dat)
  )
)

kable(
  cohort_summary,
  caption = "Aim 1 analytic cohort summary"
)

stopifnot(
  !anyNA(analytic_dat$id_persona),
  nrow(analytic_dat) == n_distinct(analytic_dat$id_persona),
  all(analytic_dat$confirmed_b),
  all(between(analytic_dat$age_at_creation, 15, 65)),
  all(between(analytic_dat$creation_year, 2005, 2023))
)
```


# Prepare descriptive variables

Original registry codes and categories are retained. Region, comuna, and country-of-origin codes are linked to the master codebook. Codes without a match remain identifiable.

```{r descriptive-variables, include=FALSE}
normalize_code <- function(x) {
  x <- trimws(as.character(x))
  x[x == ""] <- NA_character_
  sub("^([0-9]+)\\.0+$", "\\1", x)
}

region_lookup <- region_codes %>%
  transmute(
    region_key = normalize_code(`Region Code`),
    region_name = as.character(`Region name`)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(region_key))

comuna_lookup <- comuna_codes %>%
  transmute(
    comuna_key = normalize_code(`Comuna Code`),
    comuna_name = as.character(`Comuna`)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(comuna_key))

country_lookup <- country_codes %>%
  transmute(
    country_key = normalize_code(`Country Code`),
    country_name = as.character(`Country Name`)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(country_key))

# Prevent joins from multiplying registry records.
stopifnot(
  !anyDuplicated(region_lookup$region_key),
  !anyDuplicated(comuna_lookup$comuna_key),
  !anyDuplicated(country_lookup$country_key)
)

analytic_dat <- analytic_dat %>%
  mutate(
    region_key = normalize_code(cmd_cod_deis_regi_benef),
    comuna_key = normalize_code(comuna),
    country_key = normalize_code(cmd_cod_pais_origen)
  ) %>%
  left_join(region_lookup, by = "region_key") %>%
  left_join(comuna_lookup, by = "comuna_key") %>%
  left_join(country_lookup, by = "country_key") %>%
  mutate(
    age = age_at_creation,
    calendar_year = creation_year,

    sex = cmd_sexo_benef,
    chilean_foreign = cmd_cond_chile_extranj,
    fonasa_tramo = cmd_carga_tramo_benef,

    establishment_level = desc_nivel_estab_crea_caso,
    establishment_type = desc_tipo_estab_crea_caso,

    region_display = case_when(
      is.na(region_key) ~ "Missing",
      is.na(region_name) ~ paste0(region_key, " — Unmapped"),
      TRUE ~ paste0(region_key, " — ", region_name)
    ),

    comuna_display = case_when(
      is.na(comuna_key) ~ "Missing",
      is.na(comuna_name) ~ paste0(comuna_key, " — Unmapped"),
      TRUE ~ paste0(comuna_key, " — ", comuna_name)
    ),

    country_display = case_when(
      is.na(country_key) ~ "Missing",
      is.na(country_name) ~ paste0(country_key, " — Unmapped"),
      TRUE ~ paste0(country_key, " — ", country_name)
    )
  )

stopifnot(
  nrow(analytic_dat) == n_distinct(analytic_dat$id_persona)
)
```


# Characteristics of the analytic cohort

## Age at case creation

```{r table1-age}
age_summary <- analytic_dat %>%
  summarise(
    N = n(),
    Mean = round(mean(age, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
    SD = round(sd(age, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
    Median = round(median(age, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
    Q1 = round(quantile(age, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
    Q3 = round(quantile(age, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
    Minimum = min(age, na.rm = TRUE),
    Maximum = max(age, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

kable(
  age_summary,
  caption = "Age at case creation in the analytic cohort"
)
```

## Categorical characteristics

```{r table1-categorical}
table1_variables <- c(
  "sex",
  "chilean_foreign",
  "fonasa_tramo",
  "region_display",
  "establishment_level",
  "establishment_type"
)

table1_labels <- c(
  sex = "Sex",
  chilean_foreign = "Chilean/foreign status",
  fonasa_tramo = "FONASA tramo",
  region_display = "Region",
  establishment_level = "Establishment level",
  establishment_type = "Establishment type"
)

table1_categorical <- analytic_dat %>%
  select(all_of(table1_variables)) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    everything(),
    names_to = "Variable",
    values_to = "Category"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Category = if_else(
      is.na(Category) | trimws(Category) == "",
      "Missing",
      Category
    )
  ) %>%
  count(Variable, Category, name = "n") %>%
  group_by(Variable) %>%
  mutate(
    Percent = round(100 * n / nrow(analytic_dat), 1),
    `n (%)` = sprintf("%s (%.1f%%)", n, Percent)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    Variable = recode(Variable, !!!table1_labels)
  ) %>%
  select(Variable, Category, `n (%)`)

kable(
  table1_categorical,
  caption = "Table 1. Categorical characteristics of the analytic cohort"
)
```

## Country of origin

```{r table1-country}
country_summary <- analytic_dat %>%
  count(country_display, name = "n", sort = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(
    Percent = round(100 * n / nrow(analytic_dat), 1)
  ) %>%
  rename(Country_of_origin = country_display)

kable(
  country_summary,
  caption = "Recorded country of origin"
)
```

## Comuna

```{r table1-comuna}
comuna_summary <- analytic_dat %>%
  count(comuna_display, name = "n", sort = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(
    Percent = round(100 * n / nrow(analytic_dat), 1)
  ) %>%
  rename(Comuna = comuna_display)

kable(
  comuna_summary,
  caption = "Recorded comuna"
)

```

# Preliminary temporal trends


## Annual case counts

```{r annual-counts}
annual_summary <- analytic_dat %>%
  group_by(calendar_year) %>%
  summarise(
    N = n(),
    Mean_age = mean(age, na.rm = TRUE),
    Median_age = median(age, na.rm = TRUE),
    SD_age = sd(age, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(calendar_year)

kable(
  annual_summary %>%
    mutate(
      Mean_age = round(Mean_age, 1),
      Median_age = round(Median_age, 1),
      SD_age = round(SD_age, 1)
    ),
  caption = "Annual case counts and age at case creation"
)

ggplot(
  annual_summary,
  aes(x = calendar_year, y = N)
) +
  geom_col() +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(2005, 2023, 2)) +
  labs(
    title = "Annual number of individuals in the analytic cohort",
    x = "Calendar year",
    y = "Number of individuals"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

## Mean and median age by calendar year

```{r overall-age-trends}
annual_age_long <- annual_summary %>%
  select(calendar_year, Mean_age, Median_age) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(Mean_age, Median_age),
    names_to = "Statistic",
    values_to = "Age"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Statistic = recode(
      Statistic,
      Mean_age = "Mean",
      Median_age = "Median"
    )
  )

ggplot(
  annual_age_long,
  aes(
    x = calendar_year,
    y = Age,
    color = Statistic
  )
) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(size = 1.5) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(2005, 2023, 2)) +
  labs(
    title = "Age at case creation by calendar year",
    x = "Calendar year",
    y = "Age (years)",
    color = "Statistic"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

## Mean age trends by selected characteristics

The following figures show unadjusted mean age by year across observed categories. Categories are not collapsed or interpreted beyond their recorded values.

```{r stratified-trends, include=FALSE}
trend_variables <- c(
  "sex",
  "chilean_foreign",
  "fonasa_tramo",
  "region_display"
)

trend_labels <- c(
  sex = "Sex",
  chilean_foreign = "Chilean/foreign status",
  fonasa_tramo = "FONASA tramo",
  region_display = "Region"
)

stratified_summary <- analytic_dat %>%
  select(calendar_year, age, all_of(trend_variables)) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(trend_variables),
    names_to = "Variable",
    values_to = "Category"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Category = if_else(
      is.na(Category) | trimws(Category) == "",
      "Missing",
      Category
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(Variable, Category, calendar_year) %>%
  summarise(
    N = n(),
    Mean_age = mean(age, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

### By sex

```{r trend-sex}
stratified_summary %>%
  filter(Variable == "sex") %>%
  ggplot(
    aes(
      x = calendar_year,
      y = Mean_age,
      color = Category
    )
  ) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(size = 1.2) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(2005, 2023, 2)) +
  labs(
    title = "Mean age at case creation by sex",
    x = "Calendar year",
    y = "Mean age (years)",
    color = "Sex"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

## Annual mean age by selected characteristics

The table below presents the number of individuals and mean age at case creation for each calendar year and category.

```{r stratified-trends-table}
stratified_table <- stratified_summary %>%
  mutate(
    Characteristic = recode(Variable, !!!trend_labels),
    Mean_age = round(Mean_age, 1)
  ) %>%
  select(
    Characteristic,
    Category,
    calendar_year,
    N,
    Mean_age
  ) %>%
  arrange(Characteristic, Category, calendar_year)

kable(
  stratified_table,
  col.names = c(
    "Characteristic",
    "Category",
    "Year",
    "N",
    "Mean age"
  ),
  caption = "Annual mean age at case creation by selected characteristics"
)
```
